user_query: I'm planning a road trip across multiple countries and I need information about the locations I'll be passing through. Can you provide me with a list of all the locations along my route? Additionally, I would like to find educational resources related to each location to enhance my learning experience during the trip.

TaskList.description: Determine the starting and ending locations of the road trip and the countries to be passed through.
Calculate the route and retrieve a list of all locations along the specified route.
Retrieve educational resources for each location gathered in the previous step.
